Colouring, judged by eye: 43 effects, one fix

You never named a first category for the by-eye pass, so I picked the biggest, Colouring, the one you once called thin. Every effect in it is rendered by the app on the photograph its browser tile already uses, three ways: as shipped, with its main slider at a quarter, and at the top. That answers the two questions no sweep can: does it look good as shipped, and is the whole slider useful.

  • 43 effects on one photograph
  • 1 fix, shipped
  • 2 taste calls, left for you

The fix

Halation fixed in v15.81

The film look where bright lights bleed warm red. As shipped it read as nothing on a photograph at any setting, even the maximum: its mask only admitted near-white pixels (luma above 0.68 with a steep 2.4 falloff), and a photograph has almost none. The amount slider could not rescue it, because the threshold was the lever.

Now it keys from 0.5 with a 1.8 falloff. Measured on four photographs the default reading went from 0.2–1.8 to 2.1–6.3, the maximum from under 2.6 to 3–8. Projects saved before this keep their old look exactly. Top row: as shot. Middle: as it was. Bottom: now.

Two taste calls, not changed

Both are defaults doing what they were told. Say the word if you want either moved.

Gradient Overlay your call

Its default amount is 1, so adding it replaces the picture with the gradient until you pull the slider down. An overlay that starts at about half would show what it does the moment it lands.

Palette Map your call

Its default four-colour palette turns this sky into pink and green bands. It is doing its job (mapping tones to a palette), but the palette it starts with is a loud one.

Checked and left alone

Rows that looked like nothing on the sheet but measured alive, or read as nothing for a reason that is not a fault.

Bump Map, Cross Process

Gentle at their defaults, and the sheet's small tiles hide it, but both measure alive on every photograph (Bump Map 6 at defaults and 50–65 at max; Cross Process 10–12 and 16–19). No change.

Long Shadow, Radial Shadow

Read as zero on a full-frame photograph because a shadow cast off a layer that fills the frame lands outside it. On text and shapes they work as before.

HSL Bands, Match Grade, Spot Colour

Each needs something the photograph must supply: a colour in the chosen band, a reference layer, the colour to keep. Known since the first round; nothing to fix.

The whole sheet

43 rows · 630 px wide

Made by tests/_colouring-sheet.html through FM.renderScene on a real image layer. Nothing is mocked up.

What to reply

Nothing, if this is fine. The Halation fix is shipped; the two taste calls stay as they are.

Otherwise: "move Gradient Overlay" or "move Palette Map", or name the next category to judge the same way (Warping 28 · Blur 19 · Generative 19 · Stylize 19 · 3D 18 · Drawing/Edge 16 · Keying 11 · Opacity 7 · Text 6 · Repetition 5), or "no" to stop here.
